title: Senior Sales Development Representative
description:
About Us

Endor Labs is building the Application Security platform for the software development revolution. Modern software is complex and dependency-rich, making it increasingly difficult to pinpoint the risks that truly matter. Endor Labs solves this challenge by building a call graph of your entire software estate-enabling teams to clearly identify, prioritize, and fix critical risks faster. 

Trusted by companies that are one or one hundred years old, Endor Labs secures code whether it was written by humans or AI, and whether it's 40-year old C++ code or cutting edge Bazel Monorepos. Endor Labs was founded by serial entrepreneurs Varun Badhwar and Dimitri Stiliadis, and is backed by leading VC firms such as Dell Technology Capital, Lightspeed, and Sierra Ventures.

Sound interesting? Let’s talk if you want to be part of the next big leap in security innovation!

About the Sales Development Team

As a Senior Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Endor Labs, you will play a pivotal role in driving our future growth by collaborating with the Marketing and Sales  teams to qualify leads and build a robust pipeline of opportunities. You thrive on engaging with prospects, identifying high-value opportunities, and managing early sales funnel activities. You are motivated by the challenge of learning about new products and are excited to contribute to the development of our demand generation and sales process, the articulation of Endor Labs' value proposition, and the creation of key sales tools and assets. If you're proactive, intelligent, persistent, and a great team player, we want to hear from you!

You’ll join a talented but humble team that will help you accelerate your career.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Intercom
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

We are a small, dynamic team focused on building cloud-managed intercom systems. Intercom is our second newest major product line and is off to the best start of any product in Verkada’s history. Our intercom allows customers to receive calls from anywhere - at their desk or on their phone - with rich video and 2-way audio, and we have a lot more to build.

We consider our team a startup within a startup, with a fair amount of ownership and autonomy. You’ll be working alongside a dynamic team of firmware, mobile, and frontend engineers to develop this product line.

Join the fastest-growing frontier in our AI for the physical world portfolio: Intelligent Intercom Systems . The Intercom product line is a critical component of our intelligent building ecosystem, delivering rich, low-latency, multimodal interactions (video, audio, and access control integration) directly at the environment’s edge. This is a "startup within a startup" opportunity where you will have significant ownership over the architectural direction of this burgeoning product line, which is already the most successful launch in Verkada history. We have ambitious plans to disrupt  , including AI-driven visitor screening and remote environmental sensing . You will work alongside firmware, mobile, and frontend experts to drive this core element of our physical security layer.

Who You Are

• Excited by new products and startups

• You think about delivering best-in-class products and experiences - not features

• You can take a less-than-fully-fleshed-out product idea and drive it to completion

• BS or a graduate degree in Computer Science, Maths, Engineering, or science

What You Bring

• 7+ years of industry backend software engineering experience

• 4+ years of professional experience as a backend engineer at a rapidly growing start up or innovative company.

• Experience driving technical direction and leading engineers on project execution

• Architect scalable systems and design latency sensitive applications for our Intercoms deployed around the world. 

• Experience collaborating cross functionally to design complex systems with simple and robust backend APIs

• History of shipping out significant products. We are looking for someone who can own backend systems end-to-end. 

• Ownership mentality, resolving problems that span beyond team boundaries

• Deep expertise with relational databases. Postgres experience a plus

• Demonstrated expertise in either Python or GoLang

• Experience with Kubernetes a plus

title: Senior Software Engineer, Developer Infrastructure
description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Developer Infrastructure team builds the systems Sentry engineers use to develop, test, and ship software. We own local and cloud development environments, CI/CD across our open-source and private codebases, tooling for creating new services, and SDK and library publishing.

Our goal is to help engineers spend more time building for customers and less time troubleshooting their development tools. You’ll work on problems such as shortening CI feedback cycles, improving deployment reliability, detecting flaky tests, and making development environments easier to use and maintain.

As AI coding agents become part of engineering workflows, you’ll also help our environments, CI, and deployment systems support them with the context and access they need.

You’ll own projects from design through rollout and ongoing operation, working directly with engineers across Sentry to understand their needs and measure whether your changes improve their work.

This role is based in San Francisco, with three days per week in the office to work closely with Platform and Product Engineering teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build and maintain tooling for local and cloud development environments.

- Improve the speed and reliability of CI and deployment pipelines as our codebases and infrastructure grow.

- Develop supported, reusable workflows for creating services and libraries.

- Improve SDK and library publishing tools and release processes.

- Build metrics, dashboards, and flaky test detection to help teams identify and resolve development and deployment problems.

- Give engineers and AI coding agents the context they need to work within Sentry’s systems and conventions.

- Partner with engineering teams to prioritize improvements, support adoption, and evaluate results.

HOW YOU WORK

- You enjoy building tools and infrastructure other engineers rely on.

- You consider reliability, performance, cost, and maintenance when making technical decisions.

- You take ownership from understanding a problem through implementation, rollout, and operation.

- You listen to engineers’ feedback and use evidence to guide improvements.

- You help teams adopt shared tools and standards through clear reasoning and collaboration.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of software engineering experience or equivalent experience building developer tools and infrastructure.

- A track record of building or significantly improving developer tooling or infrastructure used by engineering teams.

- Strong proficiency in Python.

- Experience improving CI/CD systems, including diagnosing performance or reliability problems.

- Experience leading complex technical projects through design, implementation, and rollout.

- Experience using Docker and container orchestration in production.

- Experience working with cloud infrastructure such as GCP or AWS.

- Familiarity with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code tools.

- Experience working across engineering teams to build agreement on tools, standards, or workflow changes.

- Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical tradeoffs and documenting how systems work.

You don’t need to meet every qualification to apply. If your experience aligns with the core work, we’d like to hear from you.

The base salary range (or hourly wage range, if applicable) that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $190,000 to $400,000 USD. title: Assistant Director, Auto Product

At Liberty, our Personal Lines Auto Product team partners across the company to build and roll out auto insurance solutions that keep pace with what customers and agents need. Organized around four core areas-Delivery & Development, Underwriting Effectiveness, State Management, and Mobility Solutions-we work collaboratively to live our purpose: helping people embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Are you ready to make a significant impact in the world of personal auto insurance? Join our Personal Lines Auto Delivery team, where you'll play a key role in shaping and executing innovative pricing programs that drive USRM's profit and growth goals. You'll take ownership of end-to-end rollouts for assigned states, ensuring compliance with regulations while collaborating closely with stakeholders like the Director of State Operations. With a focus on project management , you'll simplify complex concepts and conduct deep analyses to guide strategic decisions. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and love creative problem-solving, this role offers a unique opportunity to develop your expertise in pricing and product ecosystems while fostering cross-functional partnerships. Together, we can transform the way auto insurance works!

Responsibilities:

• Fully own and execute on assigned states' end-to-end rollout of the latest personal auto insurance pricing programs.

• Gather and document product requirements, clearly communicate requirements to stakeholders, and ensure accurate implementation.

• Act as the subject matter expert for the pricing program and assigned states, provide thoughtful recommendations that influence state decisions and help drive corporate strategy.

• Lead cross-functional workstreams and manage moderate to high complexity projects.

• Conduct complex analyses to drive and support business decisions; where necessary, conduct in depth research of competitor offerings and filings.

• Educate IT partners on business vision and plan, and both IT and business partners on the impact of changes.

• Independently manage project timelines, flag risks and develop contingency plans, escalate blockers as appropriate.

• Regularly update leadership and stakeholders on project progress, addressing concerns and managing communication channels.

• Lead job shadow discussions with less experienced analysts. Provides technical training and user support to business groups.

You Would Love this Job if you:

• Like to understand how things work (soup to nuts!)

• Enjoy making a tangible impact to the state or our bottom line

• Excel at project management - this work involves many moving pieces across teams, hand-offs, coordination

• Can take complex concepts and simplify for various audiences

• Thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities

• Like to develop creative solutions to recurring and unique problems

• Have strong attention to detail

• Appreciate thought-partnering with Directors of State Operations to implement an accurate rating program

• Are a fast learner that can apply new concepts quickly

• Can work independently and manage time effectively

What you will gain from this role:

• Deep understanding of how we build and bring rating programs to market (e.g., data & mechanics)

• Deep understanding of the entire product & pricing ecosystem in USRM

• Gain exposure to many different parts of the organization (e.g., State Management, Technology, Data Science)

• Project and stakeholder management skills

• Foundational knowledge of product & pricing to succeed in Product or other parts of USRM

Qualifications

• Master's degree or equivalent in mathematics, economics, statistics, or other quantitative field

• Minimum 6 years relevant work experience, typically 8 years

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
About Flexxon
Flexxon is a Singapore-headquartered hardware technology company engineering embedded storage solutions built for the world's most demanding environments.
From factory floors to hospital wards, vehicle control units to aircraft avionics bays, Flexxon products are built into systems where failure isn't an option and a breach can mean lives, not just data, are at risk.
We're growing our marketing team and looking for a Product Marketing Manager who can identify the opportunities, translate deep technical differentiation into a value proposition that resonates with engineers, procurement teams, and C-suite buyers across five demanding verticals.
The Role
You'll own product marketing for Flexxon 's storage portfolio, working cross-functionally with engineering, sales, and design to turn technical capability into positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution that wins in Industrial, Medical, Automotive, Aerospace, and Cybersecurity-first accounts.
This is a role for someone who can sit in a room with a firmware engineer in the morning, procurement team at noon and product manager in the evening - and be equally credible in both conversations.
What You'll Own

•
Go-to-market execution - Partner with campaigns, content, design, and events teams to plan and launch product messaging across web, sales decks, trade shows, and digital channels.

•
Cross-functional bridge - Work closely with procurement, engineering and product teams to stay ahead of the roadmap and ensure marketing claims are technically defensible.

•
Customer & market research - Engage directly with design-in customers and industry analysts to validate positioning and surface unmet needs by vertical.

•
Vertical positioning & messaging - Build and maintain differentiated value propositions for each target vertical, translating technical specs (endurance, temperature tolerance, tamper-resistance, real-time threat detection) into business outcomes buyers care about.

•
Competitive intelligence - Track competitor storage and embedded-security offerings; identify gaps and craft positioning that highlights Flexxon 's hardware-level advantage.

•
Sales enablement - Develop battlecards, one-pagers, ROI narratives, and technical collateral that arm the sales team for vertical-specific conversations.
The Value Proposition You'll Champion
Vertical
What You'll Position
Industrial
Rugged, wide-temperature-range storage built for 24/7 operation in harsh, high-vibration environments - where commodity SSDs fail early and unpredictably.
Medical
Data integrity and tamper-evidence for life-critical systems, supporting compliance needs and protecting patient data at the hardware layer, not just the software layer.
Automotive
Long-lifecycle, high-endurance storage engineered for the extended service life and extreme conditions of connected and autonomous vehicle platforms.
Aerospace
Mission-critical reliability and security for systems that can't be patched mid-flight - where hardware-rooted protection is the last line of defense.
Cybersecurity
Hardware-embedded, tamper-resistant storage that protects data at the controller level - security that holds even when the operating system above it is compromised.
What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of product marketing, technical marketing, or product management experience, ideally in semiconductor, storage, embedded systems, or B2B hardware.

• Experience with competitive analysis, market sizing, and go-to-market planning.

• Demonstrated ability to translate deep technical differentiation into clear, buyer-relevant messaging.

• Experience marketing into regulated or safety-critical industries (industrial, medical, automotive, or aerospace) is a strong plus.

• Comfortable working directly with engineering teams to understand and accurately represent technical capabilities.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills - you can write a technical battlecard and present to a CEO in the same week.

title: Building Regulations & Permitting Specialist

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

- You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

- You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

- Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

- You work in close coordination with both the Head of Siting & Infrastructure, responsible for Proxima’s construction projects and the Head of Licensing & Regulation, who leads Proxima Fusion's nuclear and radiation licensing strategy - ensuring that building permit timelines and licensing requirements are sequenced correctly and never work against each other.

- Establish and maintain working relationships with relevant planning and building authorities, and specialist regulatory advisors at all locations

- Ensure permitting requirements flow upstream into the Basis of Design and structural, systems, and MEP design inputs - not the other way around; act as the bridge between regulatory constraints and the engineering team

- Prepare and manage permitting documentation in coordination with the lead architect and external planning team; own the submission process and track authority responses

- Define the regulatory landscape and way-forward playbook for Stellaris permitting preparation - including site-specific constraints, authority mapping, and timeline implications - so that when Stellaris permitting begins in earnest, the groundwork is already in place

title: Manager, Commercial Operations
description:
Manager, Commercial Operations

We are looking for a Manager of Commercial Operations to build and run the transactional engine of the commercial function inside Revenue Operations. ClickHouse runs on a usage-based pricing model, and every deal - direct, marketplace, or partner - has to land correctly in the system: quoted against the right rules, ordered against the right contract structure, and booked cleanly enough that Accounting can bill and recognize it without rework. As we scale the cloud business and widen the product line, that path has to carry more volume, more products, and more deal structures without adding people to the middle of it. This role designs the systems, automation, and controls that make that possible.

Reporting to the Director, Commercial Strategy & Operations, you will own the quote-to-order path and order management, along with the build behind it: the CPQ and quoting system requirements, the automation, the validation and controls, and marketplace transaction operations across AWS, GCP, and Azure. The goal is a commercial path where the standard deal is self-service for the field, quality is enforced by the system rather than by who touched the deal, and human review is reserved for the cases that genuinely need judgment. You will be measured by how fast and how cleanly a deal moves, how little intervention it requires, and how good the experience is for the rep. You will partner daily with Sales, Accounting, Finance, Legal, and Revenue Engineering.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own order management and automate it. Run the intake, review, and processing of quotes, order forms, and bookings to defined SLAs through quarter-end peaks, and continuously engineer the manual steps out of that path.

- Design the quote-to-order flow. Instrument the process, find where it slows or breaks, and redesign it. You own the architecture of the flow, the exception routing, and the automation that makes the standard case hands-off.

- Own the quoting and order management system build. Write the requirements, design the quoting, validation, and approval logic, drive the roadmap with Revenue Engineering, run UAT, and validate every change in production before the field sees it.

- Own the handoff into billing and revenue. Partner with Accounting so that what leaves your process arrives structured, complete, and reconcilable - and build the controls upstream that keep downstream rework from happening at all.

- Build quality in as controls. Validation rules, guided quoting, required-field logic, and automated reconciliation that make an incorrect order hard to submit in the first place.

- Own the field experience of transacting. Treat the rep as the customer: fewer steps, fewer handoffs, shorter quote cycle time, and a standard path that is obvious and self-service. Measure whether it is getting easier.

- Build and run marketplace transaction operations across AWS, GCP, and Azure. Private offers, CSP transactions, co-sell mechanics, and the tooling and automated reconciliation that keep marketplace bookings tied out across the marketplace, Salesforce, and billing.

- Operationalize commercial review. Encode approval rules and guardrails in the system so routine deals route themselves, and escalate the structures that break the system rather than quietly processing them.

- Build the transaction path for new products and acquisitions. Stand up order management, quoting, and the marketplace path for new offerings and newly acquired products, test the flow through to booking before go-live, and be ready to transact on day one.

- Own the integrity of the commercial record. Products, SKUs, pricing, contract terms, and booking attributes in Salesforce, with the controls and monitoring that keep them clean - the forecast and revenue reporting downstream depend on it.

- Instrument and report on the system you own. Cycle time, touch count, SLA attainment, exception and discount volumes, error and rework rates. Use the data t

title: Director, Technology Innovation COE
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

JOB SUMMARY:
The Director of Technology Innovation Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic leadership role responsible for governing and advancing the evaluation, selection, and deployment of emerging technologies across the supply chain organization. This individual will own and continuously refine a structured stage gate process for vetting technology innovations - ensuring that investments are rigorous, aligned to business priorities, and positioned to deliver measurable supply chain value.

This leader will serve as the bridge between technology vendors, internal stakeholders, and executive decision-makers, championing a disciplined yet agile approach to innovation.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Stage Gate Process Ownership

• Design, implement, and continuously improve a multi-stage gate framework for evaluating, piloting, and scaling supply chain technology innovations

• Define clear criteria, scoring rubrics, and decision checkpoints for each gate (e.g., ideation, feasibility, pilot, scale, sunset)

• Lead cross-functional gate review committees, facilitating structured go/no-go decisions with executive stakeholders

• Maintain a transparent innovation pipeline dashboard, tracking all active and archived technology candidates

Technology Evaluation & Scouting

• Proactively identify emerging technologies relevant to supply chain operations (e.g., AI/ML, robotics, IoT, digital twins, blockchain, autonomous systems)

• Develop and maintain relationships with technology vendors, startup ecosystems, and industry research bodies (e.g., Gartner, Forrester, industry consortiums)

• Conduct structured technology assessments including market analysis, vendor due diligence, and total cost of ownership modeling

• Represent Cencora at industry forums, innovation councils, conferences, and strategic vendor engagements; maintain awareness of supply chain innovation trends and benchmark practices across industries.

Stakeholder Engagement & Governance

• Partner with Supply Chain operations, IT, Finance, Legal, and Compliance to ensure holistic vetting of technology candidates

• Build and manage a Technology Innovation Advisory Board comprising internal subject matter experts and external advisors

• Develop executive-ready business cases and investment proposals for technologies advancing through the pipeline

• Drive alignment between innovation initiatives and the broader supply chain strategic roadmap

Portfolio & Performance Management

• Manage the innovation portfolio budget, ensuring appropriate resource allocation across stages of the gate process

• Establish KPIs and success metrics for piloted and deployed technologies, measure realized benefits including cost savings, productivity improvements and service enhancements and reporting outcomes to senior leadership

• Conduct post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and refine the vetting framework over time

Team Leadership & CoE Culture

• Lead and mobilize a cross-functional network of internal stakeholders and subject matter experts, driving innovative outcomes through influence rather than direct authority

• Build trust and credibility across Supply Chain, IT, Finance, Operations, and other functions by demonstrating deep expertise, active listening, and collaborative problem-solving

• Create alignment around a shared innovation vision by engaging stakeholders early and often throughout the stage gate process

• Design and facilitate working sessions, workshops, and forums that draw out subject matter expertise and foster co-ownership of technology evaluation decisions

title: Senior Product Manager (Athena)
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

Senior Product Manager, Athena

Chainguard secures the open source supply chain-the infrastructure underneath the majority of software running in production today. This team is building Athena, the system that makes that possible at enterprise scale. Learn more about Athena .

Athena processes vulnerability reports from enterprise customers, validates and deduplicates findings, and routes clean signals to remediation. We are building the clearing house between our customers and Chainguard’s remediation engine.

As Senior Product Manager, you will own the Athena member experience end to end-from vulnerability intake and submission through validation, remediation, and the delivery of patches and advisories. Your scope will span private feeds, the Chainguard Console, documentation, and customer-facing operations. Rather than owning a single feature, you will bring together multiple teams and related product areas to create a cohesive, scalable member experience.

This is a highly cross-functional role for a product leader who understands deeply technical enterprise customers, can create clarity from noisy input, and is comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving security environment.

What you’ll do

•
Own the end-to-end Athena member workflow and strategy: Define the product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for the member experience, from intake and validation through status visibility, remediation, and how patches and advisories appear in OSV and VEX feeds, private feeds, the registry, console, and documentation.

•
Be the primary product voice: Represent Athena internally and with customers on scope, capabilities, and direction, and educate customer-facing teams so they can communicate clearly and credibly.

•
Turn field input into a prioritized backlog: Identify systemic gaps across the member workflow, convert recurring questions, feedback, and feature requests into clear problem statements, and maintain a well-written, prioritized backlog.

•
Lead cross-functional delivery and technical tradeoffs: Align roadmaps and ownership across Engineering, remediation, Documentation, Customer Success, and other partners; work with Engineering on data validation, workflow routing, entitlements, access controls, and reliability; and partner with remediation on patch delivery, including disclosure readiness, SBOMs and provenance, breaking changes, and capacity tradeoffs.

•
Measure, flag risks, and mentor: Define and report member-experience metrics (submission volume and coverage, time to patch, status visibility, feed adoption), raise customer, delivery, and business risks early (especially around disclosure cycles), and serve as a trusted partner and mentor to product peers.

What we’re looking for

•
5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a technical B2B product serving enterprise customers in regulated industries; financial-services experience is strongly preferred. Working fluency in software supply chain security, including CVEs, OSV, VEX, SBOMs, provenance, and vulnerability disclosure.

•
Experience leading complex initiatives across multiple engineering and business teams without relying on direct authority.

•
Strong judgment when balancing customer urgency, disclosure timelines, technical constraints, and broader business priorities.

•
Comfort operating with high independence

title: Prepress Operator
description:
LearnTastic is looking for an experienced Prepress Operator to join our production workflow remotely.
You will work closely with our account managers and in-house prepress team to keep moving efficiently, maintain print quality, and meet production deadlines.
This is a hands-on production role for someone with commercial printing experience who understands print specifications, colour management, imposition, and prepress workflows. We will train you on our specific templates, equipment, and processes, but you should already be confident in managing prepress independently.
Key Responsibilities:

• Review incoming files against tickets, checking trim size, bleed, margins, image resolution, fonts, colour specifications, page count, page order, overprint, trapping, rich black, and missing assets.

• Use Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat Pro, and Enfocus PitStop to resolve prepress issues.

• Coordinate with account managers when corrections require input.

• Manage PDF proofs, generate and send proofs for approval, implement requested changes, and issue revised proofs until approval is received.

• Prepare press-ready layouts based on press specifications and paper sizes, including step-and-repeat, work-and-turn, sheetwise, booklet signatures, creep adjustments, registration marks, and colour bars.

• Create new layouts when an existing template does not accommodate dimensions or specifications.

• Process approved files through Kodak Prinergy and, where required, Fujifilm XMF, ensuring files are ready for the in-house team.

• Manage production priorities in coordination with account managers, balancing deadlines, approvals, and production requirements.

• Communicate proactively, keep account managers informed of file issues, pending approvals, and potential delays, using email, chat, and phone as needed.

What You'll Need to Succeed:

• At least 3 years of hands-on prepress experience with a commercial offset printing company, either sheetfed or web.

• Proven experience imposing print, and preparing files for production.

• Daily, practical experience with professional prepress workflows and imposition software. Kodak Prinergy and Preps are preferred; experience with Fujifilm XMF, Screen Trueflow, Heidelberg Prinect, or Agfa Apogee is also relevant.

• Strong working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat Pro on a Mac.

• Experience with Enfocus PitStop for preflight, PDF inspection, and file correction.

• A solid understanding of commercial print production, including colour separations, CMYK and spot colours, Pantone specifications, overprint, trapping, bleeds, and print marks.

• Good written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally

• Strong attention to detail, sound production judgment, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently.

• Reliable internet with speeds of at least 25 Mbps, a backup internet connection, backup power, and a quiet, suitable workspace.

Our engagements aim to eliminate obstacles, reduce risk, and accelerate timelines for customers transitioning to Google and seeking assistance with data and application modernization. As a member of our Cloud Engineering team, you will be working with fast-paced innovative companies, leveraging AI as the key driver of their transformation. Our clients will look to you as their trusted advisor, someone they can rely on and who will be there to help them along their AI journey. You will be expected to cover a large spectrum of technology topics like model optimization, high-performance training on specialized hardware (TPUs), efficient model serving (vLLM), MLOps, and complex agentic systems.

At Zencore , a Principal Architect is a key technical leader in our engineering organization and acts as an ambassador of our technical and cloud engineering expertise. Principal Architects at Zencore are able to navigate a broad technical range but are specialized in one or more domains. They are responsible for the technical oversight and end-to-end delivery of projects within our professional services business.

Whilst this is remote role, we are only considering US based candidates and do not offer visa sponsorship.

What you will do...

• Act as an external thought leader, contributing to the Zencore brand through blog posts, conference presentations, and community engagement.

• Act as a "player-coach," providing hands-on leadership and fostering a culture of deep technical excellence in AI/ML.

title: Founding Marketing Manager
description:

Anthropos is the Enterprise AI transformation platform. We help companies map, verify, and develop the skills of their workforce with AI Simulations, AI Labs, AI Interviews, and our AI Academy. Enterprises in energy, transportation, and technology use us to answer a question no HR system can: what can our people actually do, and are they ready for AI?

You will be our first marketing hire, and you will own marketing.

• Prepare offer letters and ensure a seamless transition for candidates from offer acceptance to company onboarding.

• Partner with leaders across corporate, customer experience, lab, and warehouse teams to support their Recruiting and People Operations needs.

• Experience working with HR, payroll, or benefits systems; experience with Rippling is preferred.

• Recruitment Coordination experience; experience with Workable is preferred.

• Someone who is super tech-savvy and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent written communication and people skills.

• Sound judgment when handling confidential employee information.

• A proactive approach to problem solving and the ability to work without hand holding.

• The ability to manage several priorities at once and deliver results within tight timelines.

• A dependable and responsive working style.

• Flexibility to assist with occasional time-sensitive employee needs outside standard working hours.

• Highly competitive base salary.

• Meaningful equity aligned with the scope and impact of your role.

• Flexible, remote-first work environment.

• Generous Paid Time Off and company holidays.

• 401(k).

Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.
About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017 by landscape ecologist and fire mitigation expert Harry Statter, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Our client, a dynamic Amazon FBA business, offering eco-friendly Home & Kitchen products , is seeking a Product Development Manager to lead their efforts in developing new products and improving existing ones.
This role involves close collaboration with Brand Managers and Sourcing Agents to ensure the products meet the evolving needs of the customers and maintain competitive advantage.
About the company:
It is a fast-growing brand developing several new green and sustainable products for eco-conscious consumers . Currently, the company sells mostly on Amazon, but it also operates on Shopify and Walmart. It has over 200,000 customers in 7 countries (USA, Canada, Mexico, UK, Germany, Japan, China). The company just partnered up with a sales team in the US who will work on getting its products in physical retail stores.
This work is changing the world here because his e-commerce brand is set to positively impact the lives of thousands of eco-conscious people who choose to use the companys eco-friendly products, saving tons of plastic waste and CO2 every year. The company is also committed to environmental and social causes, having planted 10,000 trees and financing plastic waste collection from the oceans through our partners at Clean Hub.
Key Responsibilities:

• Lead cross-functional teams to develop new products and enhance existing product lines.

• Manage the entire product development lifecycle from concept through design, prototyping, testing, and market introduction.

• Analyze market trends and customer feedback to identify opportunities for new products and product improvements.

• Work closely with sourcing agents to identify and evaluate suppliers, ensuring product quality and cost-effectiveness.

• Coordinate with Brand Managers to align product development with brand strategy and market positioning.

• Prepare detailed product development plans, including timelines, budgets, and resource requirements.

• Monitor and report on product development progress, including challenges and milestones.

• Monitor product performance, identify risks, issues, and problems, escalate as appropriate, proposing mitigation plans to overcome obstacles.

• Drive a focus on design and cost to ensure the delivery of excellent products to our consumers at valued price points.

• Be responsible for product documentation including specifications, manuals, packaging, case studies, product comparisons, competitor analysis, and user stories. Be an expert with respect to the competition.

• Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations and quality standards.

Qualifications:

• Minimum of 2 years experience in product development in an e-commerce company selling on Amazon

• Strong project management skills with a proven ability to lead cross-functional teams.

• Excellent analytical skills and the ability to think critically.

• Engineering background or strong understanding of manufacturing and sourcing processes.

• Creativity and innovation for improving product design and functionality.

• Ability to work independently.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams.

• Experience working with international markets and suppliers from China is highly desirable.

• Advanced English.

What We Offer:

• Fully remote and full-time role.

• Paid time off.

• Quarterly bonuses.

• Professional growth opportunities, such as managing staff members and growing your skill set.

• Competitive and timely salary.

• Opportunity to work remotely in an international company.

• Dynamic, creative work environments.

• Flexible schedule.

title: Vendor Management Contracts Associate
description:
The Vendor Management Contracts Associate supports the end-to-end administration of vendor contracts and supplier records, ensuring contracts are accurately maintained, tracked, and managed in accordance with company policies and governance requirements. Working closely with Vendor Managers, Vendor Owners, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Operational stakeholders, the role provides contract lifecycle support, maintains contract documentation, and assists with renewal, compliance, and reporting activities. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage deadlines independently are essential.
​​Role and Responsibilities​
Contract Administration & Lifecycle Support

• Support Vendor Managers and business stakeholders in the preparation, review, and administration of vendor agreements, statements of work (SOWs), amendments, renewals, and termination documentation.

• Draft vendor contracts and contract amendments using approved templates and stakeholder-provided information.

• Coordinate contract approval and execution processes, ensuring all required reviews and approvals are completed.

• Monitor contract expiry dates, renewal windows, and notice periods, proactively highlighting upcoming actions to Vendor Managers and stakeholders.

• Assist in tracking contract obligations, key milestones, and deliverables throughout the contract lifecycle.

Vendor Documentation & Governance

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date vendor records, contracts, agreements, and supporting documentation within company systems and repositories.

• Ensure all executed agreements and associated documents are filed and maintained in accordance with document management standards, naming conventions, and governance requirements.

• Support quality assurance reviews of vendor documentation to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with company policies.

• Assist with audit requests, compliance reviews, and documentation retrieval activities.

Stakeholder Coordination

• Act as a point of contact for routine vendor contract administration queries and follow-up activities.

• Coordinate communications between Vendor Managers, Vendor Owners, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and operational stakeholders as required.

• Escalate contract, compliance, or vendor-related issues to the appropriate stakeholders for review and resolution.

• Provide regular updates to the Vendor Management team regarding contract status, upcoming renewals, and outstanding actions.

Financial & Reporting Support

• Coordinate with Finance regarding purchase orders, invoices, budget tracking, and vendor payment queries.

• Support the maintenance of vendor spend, contract, and renewal reporting information.

• Prepare regular reports, dashboards, and management information relating to vendor contracts, renewals, compliance activities, and vendor data.

• Assist in the collection of information required for budget planning and vendor forecasting activities.

Process Improvement

• Support continuous improvement initiatives relating to vendor management processes, contract administration, record management, and reporting.

• Assist in maintaining contract templates, process documentation, guidance materials, and standard operating procedures.

• Identify opportunities to improve data quality, contract tracking, and administrative efficiency.

Specified Additional Responsibilities
Support and back up other team members with vendor management and onboarding activities as per the vendor management processes.
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Supply Chain, or related field. Basic knowledge in Legal area is a plus.
- Experience in contract administration, vendor management, procurement support, commercial operations, legal administration, or a related discipline.
- Understanding of contract lifecycle management principles and document control processes.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

title: Software Engineer, AI Data - Phoenix, AZ, USA
description:
Mission
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify 's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.
We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.
What Yo u’ ll Do:

• Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.

• Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.

• Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.

• Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

• A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.

• Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.

• Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.

• Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

• Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.

• Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

• A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

• A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

• Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

• The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

• Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

• The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

• An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio - a rapidly evolving tech domain

title: CNC Operator
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a CNC Operator to execute high-precision machining operations and drive manufacturing excellence on our production floor in Morrisville,NC. This role will be on the Production team and partner across the engineering organization, quality organization, and assembly teams to build next-generation hardware.

This role will be dynamic and full of new engagement, challenges, and opportunities to bring the core elements of success for an aerospace machining program-complex machine setups, tight-tolerance machining of advanced materials, rigorous tool control and FOD prevention, in-process inspection, and machine maintenance. The role will also support the development and adoption of new advanced manufacturing processes. As Anduril grows, our machining capabilities and the scope of this role will grow too. If you are someone who has passion for the quality of their work, is hands-on with advanced CNC equipment, and wants to be accountable for hardware that matters, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Operating of CNC mills, lathes, multi-axis routers

• Interpreting CAD design models.

• Implement various work holding and fixture methods, including vacuum fixtures.

• Ability to troubleshoot issues and adjust during the manufacturing process.

• Perform measurement / GD&T inspections during the manufacturing process.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Full-time on site in Anduril’s Morrisville, NC facility

• 5+ years experience as a CNC operator

• 5+ years experience with fixture setups

• Clear understanding of G and M codes.

• High level of familiarity with multi-axis and 3D machining.

• Experience with CNC Lathes

• Experience with 3/4 axis vertical Mills.

• High level of tooling and fixture experience

• Ability to take ownership of entire manufacturing process from start to finish

• Ability to adapt between R&D and short production.

• Ability to multi-task.

• U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 1+ year experience with Mastercam or similar CAM software

• Experience with Fanuc, Fagor, HAAS or Siemens control

• Familiarity with machining composites

• High level of GD&T knowledge.

• 3D printing experience

US Hourly Range
$32.22 — $41.68 USD

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. title: Team Lead Business Development (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

As a Team Lead Business Development (m/f/d) , you will be managing operational and regulatory processes such as permits, bus stop authorizations, and service documentation, along with contributing to market launches and expansion initiatives across the Black Sea region (Romania, Bulgaria and Greece).
You will be driving partner acquisition and managing the full sales lifecycle - from first contact through contract signing - while ensuring alignment with internal processes and timelines. You will oversee and support a team of BD professionals in Bucharest and Sofia, track performance, remove blockers, and coordinate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution.

About the Role

• Identify and initiate contact with new bus partners, while supporting the development of long-term strategic relationships

• Coordinate and monitor the full sales cycle (from partner acquisition to contract signing), ensuring compliance with internal procedures, timelines, and quality standards

• Lead the day-to-day management of BD managers/specialists, including priority setting, KPI tracking, performance oversight, and removal of operational blockers

• Oversee the preparation, processing, and verification of documentation required for county, inter-county, and international transport permits

• Manage operational planning activities, including preparation of timetables, price lists, itineraries, and driver schedules, ensuring submission for approval and signature

• Coordinate and monitor bus stop authorization processes across national and international networks, working closely with regulatory bodies and bus stations

• Support market expansion and new country launches, while acting as the key interface between BD and internal teams (Network Planning, Operations, Legal, Finance) to ensure smooth information and documentation flow

About You

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Transport & Logistics, or a related field

• 5+ years of experience in business development, partner management, or operations, ideally within transportation, logistics or mobility

• Previous experience in a team lead or supervisory role is mandatory

• Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools; fluency in Romanian and professional English is a must

• Solid understanding of road transport regulations and licensing procedures; experience working with regulatory bodies is a plus

• Experience in preparing operational transport documentation; CPC certification (per EC Regulation 1071/2009) is a strong advantage

• Strong communication, negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, tasks, and KPIs.

• Highly organized, proactive, team-oriented, and comfortable working on international projects

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

NB: Please submit your resume in English!

What We Offer

• Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 

• Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 

• Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 

• Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 

• Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 

• Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
Blanc Labs is a premier partner for global enterprises, leading the way in digitization, automation, and the development of next-generation digital products and services. Our expertise in digital transformation powers businesses to accelerate service delivery, drive customer engagement, and foster growth.
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Hands-on Software Architect to lead the design and evolution of modern cloud-native applications while remaining actively involved in software development. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, mentoring engineering teams, and driving architectural decisions without stepping away from coding, supporting the modernization of existing monolithic applications into distributed microservices while collaborating closely with product managers, engineering teams, and stakeholders to ensure technical solutions align with business objectives.
What You’ll be Doing:

• Design and evolve scalable software architectures for enterprise applications

• Lead the modernization of legacy monolithic systems into cloud-native microservices using patterns such as Strangler Fig, Change Data Capture (CDC), and event-driven architectures

• Develop production-ready software using Java (Spring Boot), Laravel (PHP), and React

• Design RESTful APIs and asynchronous integrations using Kafka and Amazon SQS

• Define service boundaries, data ownership, and communication strategies across distributed systems

• Architect and implement cloud solutions on AWS, ensuring scalability, resiliency, and cost efficiency

• Participate actively in coding, design reviews, and technical implementation

• Perform code reviews and promote engineering best practices across development teams

• Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive long-term improvements

• Collaborate with DevOps teams on deployment strategies, monitoring, and operational excellence

• Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership throughout the software development lifecycle

• Drive continuous improvements in architecture, development processes, and system observability

What You’ll Need to Be Successful:

• 8+ years of experience designing and developing enterprise software solutions

• Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot

• Professional experience developing applications with Laravel (PHP) and React

• Deep understanding of object-oriented design principles and software engineering best practices

• Extensive experience designing distributed systems and cloud-native applications

• Strong understanding of architectural patterns, including Microservices, Modular Monoliths, Strangler Fig, CDC, Event-Driven Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and RESTful APIs

• Experience implementing asynchronous communication using Kafka and/or Amazon SQS

• Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including MySQL, Amazon RDS, and Amazon DynamoDB

• Experience with Debezium or other CDC technologies

• Solid understanding of software design patterns (GoF) and architectural best practices

• Experience with AWS services, including ECS, EC2, DynamoDB, SQS, RDS, VPC, IAM, and Systems Manager Parameter Store

• Experience troubleshooting complex production environments

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience modernizing large-scale monolithic applications

• Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes)

• Knowledge of observability tools such as New Relic, CloudWatch, Grafana, or Prometheus

• Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation)

• Familiarity with Redis or distributed caching solutions

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) - New Bedford, MA
description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70 K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

title: Contrôleur
description:
À propos de Harris
Harris est une entreprise spécialisée dans les solutions logicielles destinées à divers secteurs, offrant des produits et services qui soutiennent les opérations essentielles de ses clients. Elle se distingue par son engagement à fournir des solutions durables, un service à la clientèle de qualité et une approche axée sur des relations à long terme, tout en favorisant l’innovation et l’excellence opérationnelle.

Contrôleur - Le rôle
En tant que contrôleur de gestion, ce professionnel sera chargé de fournir un soutien et des analyses financières qui auront une incidence directe sur la réussite de l'entreprise. Il dirigera une équipe de professionnels de la finance et supervisera les processus de clôture mensuelle, trimestrielle et annuelle, tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de direction opérationnelle en tant que conseiller de confiance.
Responsabilités et missions :

• Veiller à l'exactitude, à l'exhaustivité et à la remise dans les délais des rapports financiers mensuels

• Vérifier les rapprochements comptables, examiner les résultats mensuels et préparer les rapports destinés à la direction

• Réaliser des analyses comptables techniques conformément aux Normes internationales d'information financière (IFRS)

• Diriger, encadrer et accompagner une équipe de professionnels de la finance

• Contribuer à l'intégration des nouvelles acquisitions au sein du service financier

• Participer à l'élaboration des prévisions de chiffre d'affaires net et de charges d'exploitation

Exigences :

• Formation en comptabilité, en finance ou dans un domaine connexe;

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en comptabilité ou en finance, ou expérience équivalente;

• Titre de CPA;

• Excellent esprit d'analyse;

• Compétences avérées en matière de leadership;

• Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles et de communication;

• Une bonne maîtrise du français et de l’anglais est requise car le titulaire du poste aura à communiquer fréquemment dans les deux langues, tant oralement que par écrit. Nous avons des collègues, des clients et des partenaires au Québec, ainsi que dans le reste du Canada et aux États-Unis.

Ce que nous vous offrons :

• Une culture d’entreprise axée sur l’autonomie, l’innovation et la collaboration

• Des avantages sociaux complets (assurances collectives 100% payé par l’employeur, REER avec contribution de l’employeur, etc.)

• Un horaire flexible

• 100 % télétravail

• Des opportunités concrètes de développement professionnel

*Seuls les candidats retenus seront contactés*.
Harris s'engage en faveur d'un programme d'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi, et les candidatures des membres de groupes ciblés, y compris les femmes, les personnes handicapées, les peuples autochtones et les minorités visibles, sont encouragées. Si vous êtes une personne en situation de handicap, vous pouvez recevoir de l'aide pour le processus de sélection et de sélection sur demande.
L'équipe d'acquisition de talents de Harris n'utilise pas de messages texte pour communiquer avec les candidats ou solliciter des informations confidentielles. Nous encourageons tous les candidats à postuler aux postes affichés. Ils seront contactés soit par un gestionnaire de Harris, soit par un membre de l'équipe d'acquisition de talents pour une entrevue, à condition qu'ils répondent aux critères requis.

title: Director, Consumer Digital Product Operations
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Director, Consumer Digital Product Operations, oversees the design and execution of transformation strategies that advance organizational priorities and operational excellence. Leads cross-functional teams in identifying opportunities, defining objectives, and implementing initiatives that deliver measurable business impact. Develops transformation frameworks, governance models, and performance metrics to guide execution and accountability. Partners with executives and senior leaders to ensure initiatives are aligned with enterprise strategy and long-term goals. Provides expert consultation and transformation methodologies, organizational design, and change management practices. Oversees resource planning, budget development, and implementation of best practices to achieve sustainable results. Leads development of communications, reporting, and executive updates to share outcomes, insights, and recommendations. Builds a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement across departments. Exercises strategic judgment and decision-making to address complex challenges and ensure successful delivery of transformation outcomes at scale.  The Director, Consumer Digital Product Operations, is a high-impact leadership role that will help define how the Consumer Digital organization delivers results for customers and the business. This leader will shape and continuously evolve the organization's operating model, establishing the governance, planning processes, tools, standards, and operating rhythms that enable teams to deliver products more effectively and consistently at scale. 
Working closely with senior leaders across product, technology, design, analytics, and business functions, this individual will bring clarity to decision-making, strengthen accountability, and improve execution across the organization. By translating strategy into practical ways of working, the Director will play a central role in accelerating delivery, improving organizational effectiveness, and creating better experiences for consumers. 
Beyond product operations, this leader will oversee key organizational operations, including budget management, workforce planning, recruiting, and onboarding, team communications, and the Consumer Digital program management team. The role also serves as a steward of culture and connectivity, helping build the operating discipline, leadership practices, and organizational cohesion needed to support a high-performing and engaged Consumer Digital organization. 

Use your skills to make an impact

The Director, Consumer Digital Product Operations partners with Consumer Digital leaders and cross-functional teams to design, implement, and continuously improve an operating model that enables effective product delivery. The role translates strategy into clear ways of working, practical standards, and scalable operating mechanisms while maintaining a strong focus on customer needs and measurable outcomes. 

• Design and implement the Consumer Digital product operating model, including roles, decision rights, governance, and end-to-end ways of working.

• Design and operate OCI compute (VMs, bare-metal, OKE for Kubernetes) and storage services (Object, Block, File, Archive) optimized for workload patterns.

• Operate OCI database services, including Autonomous Database, Exadata Cloud, MySQL HeatWave, and Base Database, in close partnership with DBA teams.

• Build CI/CD pipelines on OCI DevOps service or external platforms (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) for both infrastructure and applications.

• Implement observability using OCI Monitoring, Logging, APM, and integrations with third-party observability stacks.

• Drive ongoing cost optimization through right-sizing, lifecycle management, and architectural simplification.

• Design disaster-recovery and business-continuity solutions across OCI regions and availability domains.

• Strengthen security posture using OCI Cloud Guard, Security Zones, Vault, and Data Safe, and lead remediation of findings.

• Advise application development teams on OCI-native design patterns and best practices.

• Develop automation tooling in Python, Bash, and Terraform to reduce operational toil.

• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal cloud communities of practice.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with strong hands-on time on OCI.

• Production-level experience with infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

• Solid experience with OCI compute, networking, storage, identity, and database services.

• Hands-on experience with Oracle Container Engine for Kubernetes (OKE).

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines for cloud workloads.

title: Support Engineer (DevTools & AI Reliability, remote)
description:
(Remote, US East Coast or the same time zone. Series B. DevTools SaaS. Synthetic monitoring. 40h/week)

The best developers don’t wait for a customer to tell them something’s broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly’s whole reason to exist. Now that agents write and ship more and more code, they can carry that instinct too. Agents write, run, and maintain the monitoring setup that guards production, while developers stay in control. Everything is defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, and versioned and reviewed like everything else that ships. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

AI agents are shipping more code than any team can review, and reliability is lagging behind. Checkly closes this gap. As a Support Engineer, you’ll support our most valuable customers, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password on that journey.

In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B https://www.checklyhq.com/blog/announcing-20m-to-enable-engineers-to-detect-and-r/ funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel. We’re a remote-first startup that is low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love actually listening to and working with customers, working async, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

We care about building a team where people of all backgrounds are encouraged to do their best work. To achieve this we built a flexible and async-first https://blog.checklyhq.com/how-to-build-a-leading-remote-first-company-while-exceeding-company-goals-do-this/ startup environment with inclusive benefits https://www.notion.so/ad474bec3a5d4d17bfbb43ebae3fec9c?pvs=4 and full transparency about how we pay.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Support has always been about solving real problems for real people. What’s changing at Checkly is how we do it: AI lets us automate routine work and assist us with troubleshooting, so we can go deeper on hard cases and bring what customers tell us straight back to the product. Here’s where you come in:

- Resolve customer issues. Debug Playwright tests (flaky selectors, timeouts, auth flows). Dig into API check failures with packet captures (PCAPs), traceroutes and timing breakdowns. Set up single sign-on (SSO) and SAML. When it’s a bug, bring engineering a clean reproduction, or open the pull request (PR) yourself.

- Build an outstanding AI support process. Our internal and external support agents already resolve 80% of tickets. You’ll help lift the bar: what the agent answers, when it hands off to a human, and how good those answers are.

- Turn tickets into product. Spot patterns across customers and bring product and engineering a reproduction. Your work becomes bug fixes and features.

- Own the docs. If you’ve answered something twice, it belongs in the docs and in the agent, so customers and AI get the same right answer.

- Work with modern tooling. We are continuously updating our workbench, and you’ll have modern tools like Plain, Linear, and Mintlify.

THIS WON'T BE THE RIGHT ROLE IF YOU...

- Want a clear process for every situation before you act.

- Would rather code all day than talk to customers.

- See AI tools as something you’ll get around to eventually.

- Want the structure and pace of a large company.

WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE

You will often speak with developers who need assistance understanding if their applications work well and if not, what caused the issue. This requires a solid technical background and a genuine motivation to help and learn.

- Empathy: You love working with customers and solving their problems. Checkly is critical to them, and we genuinely want to unblock them.

- Some experience in a technical role, for example, as a developer or in technical support.

- You can read and debug JavaScript, TypeScript and Node.js code.

- You’re comfortable with HTTP, REST APIs, browser dev too

This role engages directly with providers to identify barriers, refine workflows, enhance EHR tools, and support adoption of efficient documentation practices.
