title: UX & Performance Designer
description:
Releaf is the UK's leading medical cannabis clinic. With over 170 staff, we connect patients with specialist clinicians, streamline access to prescriptions, and support thousands of people across the UK. We're on a mission to rethink healthcare - making specialist medical care more accessible, more human, and more effective.
The role
You'll report into our Head of Performance Marketing and sit within the performance team, working closely with our Paid Search and Paid Social Specialists. This is a hands-on design role split across two areas:
UX for paid media landing pages. You'll have full accountability for the design of our paid media landing pages: the experience someone has the moment they click an ad. User flows, wireframes, final designs, testing and iteration are all yours, and so is making them convert.
Design for paid channels. You'll create the static and video creative that runs across our paid media, predominantly Meta ads, with other channels likely to follow as we grow.
Owning both ends of the journey means you control the message from first impression to conversion. The best person for this job understands that a great ad isn't just one that looks good. It stops the scroll, earns the click, and lands on a page that converts. You'll be doing it in a category where advertising is tightly regulated, so accuracy and compliance matter as much as performance.
Main responsibilities
Paid media landing pages

• Own the UX and design of our paid media landing pages end to end, from user flows, wireframes and prototypes through to final designs and QA on the live page

• Design mobile-first, fast, accessible pages with a clear path from first click through to booking a consultation

• Plan and run a continuous landing page testing roadmap with the performance team: layouts, messaging, forms, page structure and offers

• Use GA4, heatmaps and session recordings to understand how people actually use our pages and where they drop off, and turn that into the next iteration

• Build and maintain a landing page design system and component library, so new pages and variants can go live quickly

• Work with our developers and partners to get pages built accurately, and own the quality of what goes live

Paid channel creative

• Produce static and video creative for Meta, built to perform and iterate on quickly: hooks, formats, angles, static vs video

• Work closely with our Paid Social Specialist on the creative testing roadmap, turning briefs and performance data into the next round of creative

• Edit and produce short-form video, from UGC assembly through to fully motion-designed pieces, with sound and subtitling for social

• Adapt and extend creative for other paid channels as we grow, such as display, YouTube, TikTok or digital out-of-home

Across both

• Make sure the message matches from ad to landing page, so the journey feels like one joined-up experience

• Work within the advertising regulations specific to our sector, making sure every ad and page is compliant before it goes live, and working with our compliance team on reviews and amends

• Build and maintain templates and brand assets so the team can move faster

• Keep output consistent with brand guidelines while adapting to the demands of each channel

• Stay current on platform formats, UX best practice and what's actually working

What we're looking for
Essential

• At least 3 years' professional design experience (ideally 5), covering both UX or web design and paid or performance creative

• A portfolio that shows both: landing pages or web journeys you've owned (with results if you have them), and paid social creative that ran

• Solid UX fundamentals: user flows, wireframing, prototyping, information hierarchy, and mobile-first, accessible design

• Hands-on experience testing and optimising landing pages and ad creative, and an instinct for performance: you understand why a hook or a page works, not just how to execute one

• Strong static and motion craft

The role: What's in the Box

You’ll join our HSE (Health, Safety & Environment) team in Bleiswijk as an HSE Specialist ( Veiligheidskundige ), helping bring the HSE strategy to life at our Distribution Center and logistics hubs. You’ll be the go-to person for all health, safety and arbo matters on site. Think forklift traffic, manual handling, ergonomics and chilled storage areas, with a large and diverse team working across multiple shifts. Making safety stick here is as much about people and behavior as it is about procedures.

Most of your time will be spent on the floor, spotting risks before they become incidents and working with teams to solve them. Your biggest impact will be on our safety culture: helping people understand not just what needs to be done, but why it matters, so that safety becomes something everyone owns.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Conduct risk assessments, workplace inspections and incident investigations, and follow up on actions with operational teams to keep improving safety performance.

• Lead root cause analysis on incidents and near misses, and turn your findings into clear, practical procedures.

• Design and deliver trainings, toolbox talks and awareness sessions that build safety ownership across all teams and shifts.

• Support managers and team leads in applying HSE policies and staying compliant with Dutch health and safety legislation.

• Run internal audits and compliance checks, and share findings and progress with the HSE team and site leadership.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to design practical, sustainable solutions for risks and unsafe situations.

• Be visible on the work floor: listen, observe and empower employees to speak up and take safety into their own hands.

Additional details

• Work location: Bleiswijk (on-site presence required), with occasional visits to our logistics hubs

• Work-from-home flexibility: 1 day per week

• Working hours: Monday to Friday, during office hours

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• A bachelor’s degree with an MVK or HVK qualification, or a background in integral safety (IVK).

• Experience in a Health & Safety role, ideally in logistics, production or manufacturing.

• Solid knowledge of Dutch health and safety legislation and risk assessment methods, plus hands-on experience with incident investigation, root cause analysis and internal audits.

• Strong communication and influencing skills: you motivate rather than enforce, and you know how to bring people along.

• A hands-on, organized approach: you go to the floor, co-create solutions, and keep priorities clear in a fast-paced, changing environment.

• Full professional proficiency in English. Ideally, you also speak Dutch at a professional or native level.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

As the Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer , you will lead the design and development of next-generation patient care products - from concept through production - translating caregiver feedback, customer reviews, and competitive insights into profitable, manufacturable solutions with exceptional ergonomics, usability, and functional detail.

With thousands of positive reviews and a passionate, diverse team from around the globe, the company prides itself on creating products that are not only well-designed but genuinely useful. • Optimize design-to-prototype cycle times and improve design efficiency.

• Maintain high standards of manufacturability, functional performance, and customer satisfaction (targeting 4.5+ product ratings).

• Communicate effectively with international manufacturing partners, including Asian/China suppliers.

Expected Outcomes:

• Deliver 4-6 fully engineered, manufacturable product designs within the first 3 months.

• Develop final production-ready samples of 12-18 new SKUs by the end of 2026.

• Achieve 30% contribution margin in design cost modeling.

• Optimize and meet quarterly design-to-prototype cycle time targets within the first 6 months.

• Implement a structured, user-driven design process for top legacy products within 12 months.

• Establish and maintain a repeatable, scalable design documentation system.

Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience in Industrial Design or Product Design.

• 2+ years designing mass-produced consumer, HME, or DME (patient care) products.

• Experience taking products from concept to mass production.

• Experience in mechanical design, prototyping, simulation, and testing.

• Experience working within manufacturing and supplier constraints.

• Experience communicating and collaborating with Asian/Chinese manufacturers.

title: AIS ISC Digital & AI Capabilities, Director

Job Description Summary
We are seeking a Director to lead AIS ISC Digital & AI Capabilities, the AI, analytics, and data organization within the AIS Integrated Supply Chain.

This leader-of-leaders role will oversee a team of approximately 18, including Digital Leads, Product Owners, and Data Governance specialists, supporting five core supply chain processes: Market to Order, Forecast to Plan, Source to Pay, Plan to Produce, and Produce to Deliver.

You will own the overall digital and analytics roadmap, ensuring governed KPI products, consistent data definitions, strong data governance, and trusted data foundations that enable business teams to self-serve analytics and AI solutions.

A key priority will be leading Heartbeat, a unified SQDC analytics product designed to replace 500+ fragmented operational reports with a single, drillable source of truth integrated into daily management systems.

While your teams will build and own the governed KPI products, you will remain hands-on and technically credible, able to address complex cross-process analytics, executive requests, and emerging business needs. Job Description

Lead the Organization

•
Lead leaders. Select, develop, and grow four Digital Leads and a Data Governance Lead, with full accountability for the capability, performance, succession, and bench strength of the whole organization - Product Owners and Data Stewards included.

•
Hold the bar through your leads. Ensure the review standard for SQL, semantic models, and metric logic is real in every pillar - sampling the work often enough to know, without becoming the bottleneck.

•

•
Protect the balance between running certified products, improving them, and building new capability.

Deliver the Single Source of Truth

•
Own the goal. Consolidate the Heartbeat Bowler KPIs (L0-L4) into one certified source of truth connected to daily management systems - the organization’s reason to exist.

•
Lead Factory Heartbeat. Deliver the unified PSQDC analytics product - single drillable dashboard, integrated action tracking linked to problem solving, real-time data - and drive the disciplined retirement of the fragmented reporting it replaces.

•
Advance the Digital Framework maturity. Move each process from Organized to Digitized to Connected, with certified foundational data products as the gate - and report that maturity honestly to the business.

Run the Hub, Enable the Spokes

Own the fundamentals only the hub can own. Certified data products, one agreed definition per KPI, approved data connectors, platform standards, and certification - the non-negotiables that make everything built on top trustworthy.

•
Make the platform self-service. Publish certified products as documented, discoverable, consumable components - through Digital Compass and the data marketplace - so business users across segments, sites, and functions build their own analyses, reports, and AI use cases on trusted foundations, without a ticket queue.

Set the certified / experimental boundary. Define what self-built, experimental work may touch versus what production and executive use requires - and provide the path for a spoke-built

title: Red Team Tester (Junior)
description:
Position Description
Valiant Solutions is seeking a Red Team Tester - Junior to support authorized red team, penetration testing, and adversarial security assessments across our government customer's systems and applications. Working under the guidance of senior team members, you will identify exploitable vulnerabilities, validate security controls, document attack paths, and deliver actionable findings that strengthen the customer's cybersecurity posture. You will build test scenarios around real-world adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and document your work using the MITRE ATT&CK framework
Named one of the Washington Business Journal’s Best Places to Work every year since 2014 , Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!
Location: Remote with ad hoc travel to the Washington DC Metro area.
This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.
Required Clearance: Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
Eligibility Requirements: U.S. citizenship is required to obtain the necessary clearance for this position.
Required Experience:

• 3 to 5 years of work experience in the subject area.

• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent applicable experience.

• An industry professional certification; Security+, CEH, eJPT, PNPT, or OSCP preferred.

• Hands-on cybersecurity experience in penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, security testing, ethical hacking, or related activities.

• Working knowledge of network protocols, operating systems, web technologies, and common security vulnerabilities.

• Familiarity with penetration testing methodology and vulnerability exploitation.

• Understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and common attacker TTPs.

• Experience with tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Wireshark, Nessus/Tenable, BloodHound, or comparable offensive security tools.

• Familiarity with Windows and Linux environments.

• Scripting experience in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.

• Exposure to AWS cloud security testing.

• Ability to clearly document technical findings and remediation recommendations.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

• Familiarity with NIST SP 800-115.

Responsibilities:

title: Ingénieur Intégration Sécurité (H/F)
description:
Votre rôle
Au sein d’une équipe projet spécialisée en sécurité des réseaux, vous interviendrez sur la conception, l’intégration et le déploiement de solutions de sécurité chez les clients. À ce titre, vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

• Pilotage et réalisation des projets d’intégration : participer aux phases d’ingénierie, d’installation, de configuration, de migration et de mise en production des solutions de sécurité, dans le respect des exigences techniques et des délais définis.

• Conception et implémentation d’architectures de sécurité : contribuer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre d’architectures adaptées aux besoins des clients, en tenant compte des contraintes d’infrastructure, de performance, de disponibilité et de sécurité.

• Déploiement et évolution des solutions : assurer l’intégration des équipements et solutions de sécurité réseau, notamment les firewalls, les proxies, les solutions de protection des endpoints et les solutions de sécurité Cloud.

• Rédaction de la documentation technique : élaborer les dossiers d’architecture, les spécifications techniques générales et détaillées, les procédures d’installation et d’exploitation ainsi que les comptes rendus d’intervention.

• Migration et mise en production : préparer et réaliser les opérations de migration, effectuer les tests de bon fonctionnement, valider la conformité des configurations et accompagner la mise en service des solutions.

• Support technique et résolution d’incidents complexes : apporter une expertise technique lors des phases d’intégration, analyser les dysfonctionnements rencontrés chez les clients et proposer des solutions correctives adaptées.

• Transfert de compétences : accompagner les équipes techniques et les clients dans la prise en main des solutions déployées, en partageant les bonnes pratiques d’utilisation, d’administration et d’exploitation.

• Veille technologique et amélioration continue : suivre les évolutions des technologies de sécurité, évaluer les nouvelles solutions du marché et contribuer à l’amélioration des méthodes, des architectures et des pratiques d’intégration.

Votre profil
De formation Bac+4/5, vous justifiez d’au moins 4 ans d’expérience en cybersécurité, idéalement chez un intégrateur.
Vous disposez de solides compétences techniques sur les solutions de sécurité réseau :

• Fortinet,

• Check Point,

• Palo Alto,

• Juniper)

• du loadbalancing (F5), de proxy (BlueCoat, IronPort),

• de sécurité des endpoints (SentinelOne, CrowdStrike, Trend Micro, McAfee, Symantec) et de sécurité Cloud (CASB).

Passionné(e) par les nouvelles technologies, vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre expertise technique, votre excellent relationnel et vos capacités rédactionnelles.
Vous savez évoluer dans des environnements multi-projets et multi-clients, tout en faisant preuve d’autonomie, de rigueur et d’un bon esprit d’équipe.
Entité
Orange Cyberdefense est l’entité stratégique du Groupe Orange dédiée à la sécurité numérique. Nous accompagnons les entreprises de toutes tailles, organismes critiques, administrations et collectivités locales dans la conception de leurs stratégies de cybersécurité, leur mise en œuvre et leur gestion opérationnelle.
Nous leur apportons notre expertise afin d’assurer le meilleur niveau de protection de leurs données, de leurs équipements et des services qu’ils offrent à leurs clients ou leurs administrés.
Avec un CA de 1,3 Md€ en 2025, 7% de croissance et plus de 3.300 experts dédiés à la cybersécurité, nous nous positionnons aujourd'hui comme le Leader européen sur le marché de la cyberdéfense.
Notre vocation est de construire une société numérique plus sûre.

title: Work with Ukraine
description:
Твоя кар’єра з Київстар. Приєднуйся до команди!
Не знайшли вакансію, яка відгукується саме вам? Або ще шукаєте напрям, у якому хочете розвиватися? Не обов’язково чекати на ідеальну вакансію, щоб зробити перший крок назустріч новим можливостям!
Залишайте своє резюме в Київстар - давайте знайомитися!
Київстар - це більше, ніж телеком. Це команда людей, які створюють технології, розвивають цифрові продукти, реалізують масштабні проєкти та щодня роблять внесок у майбутнє України.
Ми шукаємо таланти з різним досвідом, навичками та амбіціями. Незалежно від того, чи ви вже досвідчений фахівець, чи тільки розпочинаєте свій кар’єрний шлях, - у Київстар можуть знайтися можливості саме для вас.
Чому Київстар?
Безбар’єрне середовище. Поважаємо індивідуальність кожного та створюємо простір, де комфортно бути собою.
Гнучкість у роботі. Гнучкий графік та гібридний формат роботи залежно від посади.
Турбота про добробут. Страхування здоров’я та життя, соціальні гарантії й додаткова підтримка у важливих життєвих ситуаціях.
Розвиток без обмежень. Навчання, менторство, внутрішні кар’єрні можливості та інструменти для професійного зростання.
Підтримка, коли це потрібно. Програми ментальної та емоційної підтримки для співробітників і їхніх родин.
Комфортний старт. Продумана адаптація та колеги, які підтримують із першого дня.
Підтримка захисників і захисниць. Програма «4.5.0. Нарешті вдома» для військових, ветеранів та їхніх родин.
Робота зі змістом. Ми підтримуємо країну, суспільство й армію та створюємо проєкти, що мають значення для мільйонів українців.
Як це працює?
Залишайте своє резюме.
Наша команда рекрутингу ознайомиться з вашим досвідом та професійними інтересами.
Якщо з’явиться можливість, яка відповідає вашому профілю, ми зв’яжемося з вами, щоб обговорити наступні кроки.
Можливо, саме зараз починається ваша наступна кар’єрна історія. І ми будемо раді, якщо вона буде з Київстар!

Детальніше про нас:
Зазирніть в наш Instagram - там про людей, культуру та життя в Київстар → https://www.instagram.com/kyivstar.people
А останні новини про нас шукайте в LinkedIn --> https://www.linkedin.com/company/kyivstar/

Якщо в тебе залишились питання, ти можеш задати їх нам, рекрутерам Київcтар. Переходь в наш телеграм канал «Кар'єра з Київстар» і давай спілкуватись! 

Робота в Київстар, який входить до міжнародної Групи компаній Київстар, вимагає від нас дотримання високого рівня ділової етики, юридичних зобов'язань, наших цінностей та Кодексу поведінки міжнародної Групи компаній Київстар, визначених політик і процедур. Ми прагнемо бути чесними та відкритими, діяти етично, правдиво і сумлінно. Ми розуміємо важливість захисту ваших Персональних даних та прагнемо використовувати провідний досвід у цьому напрямі. Натиснувши кнопку «Відгукнутися на вакансію», ви підтверджуєте, що ви прочитали, зрозуміли та явно погодилися з нашою Політикою конфіденційності.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Southern Europe
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters - keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

YOUR TASKS

- Build and execute plans for named enterprise accounts, prioritising the organisations and use cases with the strongest potential.

- Generate pipeline through thoughtful, account-based outreach and create access to stakeholders across multiple business units.

- Lead consultative discovery to understand customer priorities, identify cross-functional projects and establish where Statista can deliver measurable value.

- Develop business cases that connect Statista’s solutions to customer outcomes and support the investment decision.

- Map buying groups, build stakeholder support and maintain momentum through complex approval processes.

- Own new-business revenue targets, deal strategy, forecasting and the commercial process through procurement, legal and close.

- Hand over won accounts with clear context on stakeholders, objectives and agreed outcomes.

YOUR PROFILE

- 4-8 years of B2B new-business sales experience, with a track record of creating and closing opportunities.

- Experience selling into large, multi-division organisations and managing complex buying groups.

- Confidence in named-account planning, self-sourced prospecting and executive-level conversations.

- Strong discovery skills and the ability to build evidence-based commercial cases.

- Experience navigating procurement, approvals and negotiations through to signature.

- Fluent English and business-level proficiency in French, Italian or Spanish. Additional southern european languages are an advantage.

- Able to work from our London office, opposite Southwark Station, two days a week, and travel for customer meetings and industry events.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

- Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

- Hybrid work and flex-time

- International team and social events

- Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

- Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

- Career & training opportunities

- Attractive locations and modern offices

- Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

title: AFFILIATE PARTNERSHIPS MANAGER
description:
AFFILIATE PARTNERSHIPS MANAGER
We Realize Potential in Your Story

We are a multi-platform production company, social media agency, and digital media network who are currently on a quest to find a Affiliate Partnerships Manager to join our Network team - Is this your next opportunity?
We're looking for an individual to help power one of the largest deal-focused channels on YouTube (3M subscribers). The Affiliate Partnerships Manager will own, scale, and optimize the affiliate commerce revenue engine for one of our lead Creator channels. In this role, you will lead publisher-side affiliate strategy and day-to-day commercial relationship management, partnering directly with top-tier US retail merchants and affiliate networks. Working closely with the Content and Channel Management teams, you will be tasked with maximizing earnings via affiliate links/shopping features. You will be responsible for proactively negotiating bespoke commission increases, securing exclusive promotional codes and advance deal sheets for marquee shopping events (such as Prime Day and Black Friday/Cyber Monday), and aligning high-converting retail deals with our content calendar. You will collaborate closely with the Channel Manager and the content production team to integrate affiliate links seamlessly into video descriptions, community posts, and newsletters while maintaining audience trust and strict compliance.
HOW YOU WILL SPEND YOUR TIME
Retailer partnership management and business development

• Manage and scale direct relationships with major US retail partners, (eg. Amazon and Walmart) alongside major affiliate networks (eg. Impact, CJ Affiliate, MagicLinks).

• Pitch and negotiate with retailers and networks to secure beneficial commission rates, hybrid campaign fees, performance bonuses, exclusive merchant coupon codes, and curated landing pages to drive maximum revenue yield.

• Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for brand affiliate managers, affiliate PR reps, and network account teams.

Affiliate strategy and operations

• Own and execute the commercial affiliate playbook for the Creator channel, including around major retail tentpole events such as Amazon Prime Day, Fall Prime Day, Black Friday, Cyber Monday, and Q4 holiday shopping.

• Regularly liaise with merchant partner contacts (including well in advance of tentpole dates) to secure embargoed deal sheets, early bird promotions, high-tier commission incentives, and guaranteed exclusive promotional codes.

• Coordinate with content and channel production leads to plan timely content releases that capitalize on real-time flash sales and lightning deals.

Product curation and link operations

title: Head of Growth (Paid Media + Client Accounts + AI) | Marketing for Multi-Locatio
locationText: Anguilla, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina +45 more
description:
Company Overview
Our client is a marketing team that works inside businesses with many locations, such as senior living communities, med spas, dental and healthcare groups, cannabis retailers, and schools. Its clients are in the US and Canada, and they pay a flat fee instead of a percentage of ad spend.
The company runs on Claude and has built its own operating system and client portal. AI agents do most of the production, so a small team can run a lot of client work.
Your Role
As Head of Growth, you're the final decision-maker on 6 to 10 client accounts, across paid media, websites, CRM, and creative. Agents and teammates bring you options, and you pick one, approve it, or send it back with the exact fix.
You report to the CEO and work as a peer to the founders. You'll start by taking over the approval queue on every active account. By day 90, delivery runs without the CEO in the loop, and you've built the tool or process that lets the team take on 5 more accounts with the same people.
Part of the job is building. You'll release features to the internal platform by directing Claude Code: you write the spec, test it on staging, and merge it. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to know exactly what you want and check that you got it.
This isn't an account manager role. If you've mostly passed the calls on spend, creative, or pricing to someone else, or you'd rather delegate to a team of specialists, it probably isn't the right fit.
You'll

• Run the client relationship with owners, executive directors, and sales teams

• Approve Google Ads and Meta builds before launch

• Adjust budgets and bids, and cut the search terms that bring no leads

• Own conversion tracking across GTM, GA4, and offline imports from the CRM

• Direct WordPress rebuilds, then own go-live, redirects, and Search Console

• Connect CRMs, call tracking, and forms so each lead can be followed to the sale

• Approve client pricing changes, promotions, and policy pages

• Sign off on weekly and monthly client reports before they go out

You Bring

• 7+ years running marketing or growth for clients or at an agency

• Final say on a client's ad spend, creative, or pricing, and you can name the decision

• Google Ads and Meta campaigns you built and managed yourself

• Daily work with Claude or a similar tool, and something real you released through it, like a site, an ad build, an automation, or code

• The habit of checking AI output before it goes live

• Comfort with tag managers, CRMs, DNS, and webhooks

• Near-native English, and confidence saying no to a client on a call

• The drive to grow with the company as it takes on more accounts

Bonus Points

• Marketing work in senior living, med spas, dental, healthcare, cannabis retail, or education

• Experience with industry CRMs such as ALIS, Pagoda, or Dutchie

• Advertiser verification, A2P 10DLC registration, or HIPAA and cannabis ad rules handled yourself

• WordPress beyond the editor, like themes, plugins, or a staging-to-production deploy

• SQL, GitHub pull requests, or Supabase

What's Offered

• Fully remote, full-time contractor role from LATAM

• Working hours on US business hours

• Paid in USD as a contractor. Share the range that fits your level and we'll go from there

• Unlimited PTO, used responsibly, and you choose which holidays to take

• A direct line to the CEO, with the founders as your peers

• Room to grow as the company takes on more accounts

Interview Process
1️⃣ First Call: A 30-minute conversation with atomic✳HR
2️⃣ CEO Interview: The accounts you've run and the decisions that were yours
3️⃣ Co-founder Interview: How you'd work as a peer, and the final decision
4️⃣ Work Test: Possibly a short exercise, and you'll know how it's judged first

title: Backend Developer
description:
Description
MuseHub is where millions of creators get their music tools: Muse Sounds, plugins, sample libraries and apps like MuseScore and Audacity, all in one desktop app and web storefront. We relaunched it this fall with ambitious goals, and now we’re looking for someone to own its backend.
Today MuseHub runs on its own Azure and .NET stack. Your mission is to move it onto the shared Muse platform (modern PHP), make it much faster, and then take full ownership of it. You’ll be the go-to backend engineer on a product team that ships fast.

We are actively integrating AI automation into relevant areas of the business and expect candidates with mindset focused on improving efficiency and deliver a better user experience.
Key responsibilities

• Own the MuseHub backend: catalog, search, accounts, orders and licences, the APIs behind the web storefront and the desktop app.

• Break TTFB down by layer (edge, application, database calls, the experiment-assignment request before render), write the diagnosis and fix the causes.

• Write the migration plan with a date per service, then move the backend from Azure to the Muse PHP stack on the shared Kubernetes platform, service by service, with no downtime for buyers.

• Move sign-in from Azure B2C to MuseID, including sign-up inside checkout.

• Move experiment assignment to the Muse A/B service.

• Set up monitoring, safe deploys and rollback in the shared Muse tooling.

• Work with the frontend developer on the Next.js storefront and with the desktop developer on the APIs the app uses.

• Review code, write tests for new code, and use AI coding tools in daily work.

Requirements

• 5+ years of modern PHP (8.0+) in production web backends

• Migrated a live product from one stack or cloud to another without downtime

• Database work: profiling, indexes, query plans, caching, queues and background jobs (MySQL)

• Production operations: logging, monitoring, debugging in prod, safe migrations, zero-downtime deploys

• Docker and Kubernetes

• Unit and integration tests, Git, code review, CI/CD

• Basics of PCI and PII compliance for payments and accounts

• Fluent English

Nice to have

• Yii2 or the Muse backend packages

• Can read C#/.NET, to take over the current backend

• Azure (App Service, Cosmos DB, Redis, B2C)

• Elasticsearch or another search engine

• OAuth/OIDC sign-in and payments (Stripe)

• Web performance: TTFB, caching at the edge, Cloudflare

• Uses AI coding assistants daily
